Bass-Kiosk-v15.9-x86_64-OFFICIAL-vanilla-2024110214

Bass OS - Android 12.1 - Kiosk Launcher (watermarked) variant

This is the initial GitHub Release for Bass-Kiosk-v15.9-x86_64-OFFICIAL-vanilla-2024110214, and this update includes a number of changes on top of where our last Kiosk build was.

!! This build is not rooted, but you can use adb root !!

Updates since last POS build:

● Pulled updates from Bliss OS 15.9.x
● Fixes for dual booting windows systems
● Included per-window rotation support for multi-displays
● Updates for MicroG default options
● Updated FOSS apps (Aurora Store, Neo-Store, and more)
● Updates for RestrictedLauncher (Admin Mode password protection improvements)
● Updated Bootsight service - anonymous device registration (all demo builds do not have to license and are free to use as-is) See EULA for more info
● Lots more, check the changelog and git repos for further details.

Bass Toolkit Build Options:

● --ethernetmanager
● --minfossapps
● --tabletnav
● --clearhotseat
● --nolarge
● --supervanilla
● --minimal
● --alwaysonsettings
● --sof
● --silead
● --wiz
● --aurorastore
● --usecalyxmicrog
● --privateapp
● --kiosk
● --noksu
● --grubcmdline "BTLINUX_HAL=1 androidboot.force.win_as_home=1"

Install:

● Install from Bootable USB

Setup:

!! The default password for the kiosk launcher settings is 123 !!

● Booting into Lockdown Builds

via Release notes from Bass-OS-releases (author: electrikjesus)
